points.notes: Rendered faction pages scraped with Legends shown. 'points' = first-copy price of the smallest unit size; 'models' = that size; 'pointsTiers' = per-copy price bands when MFM prices by copy number. Ultramarines use the Space Marines page, Craftworlds the Aeldari page, Agents of the Imperium the Imperial Agents page; titans use the (Chaos) Titan Legions pages.

profiles.notes: Used to fill empty M/T/Sv/W/Ld/OC lines and to complete truncated ability strings where the unit name matched one BSData unit.
